decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The roof light to be installed to the front of the house shall be fitted to be flush with the plane of the roof.

Condition : 5 - Informative: The proposed roof extension must not be higher than any part of the existing ridge of the roof. The original ridgeline and ridge capping of the house should be maintained.

Condition : 6 - 10.2	The erection of a rear roof extension to the existing dwellinghouse and installation of one roof light to the front roof, as shown on drawing numbers 116-A11 Rev. C, 116-A12 Rev. C, 116-A13 Rev. C and 116-A14 Rev. C received 18 December 2006 (Amended plans), would not unduly harm the appearance of the existing building and street scene or the amenity of neighbouring properties and is considered to preserve and enhance the appearance and character of Grove park Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development is consistent with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas, and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Erection of a rear roof extension with 1 roof light to front of the house
